criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`. It passes in full, with no failing tests. If any test fails, the recorded output names it, and the CHANGELOG states whether it also fails at the base commit.
criteria.evidence: Athena's record for this tree: `cargo test --locked` passed (1617 tests ran). No test failed, so nothing has to be named or classified against the base.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list`. The test names and count equal those of the base commit, and `produce_and_verify_order_tests::a_fake_job_takes_its_baseline_before_the_producer_and_numbers_the_invocations_in_order` passes.
criteria.evidence: The list ran on the candidate. The filtered run shows 12 passed and 613 filtered out, so the lib has 625 tests, and the named test passed. I could not build the base, because checking it out would change git state. Equality with the base holds by construction instead: `git diff HEAD~1` changes no test file, and its only hunks in run/mod.rs are at line 53 (mod/use) and line 1121 (the produce_and_verify body), so no test was added, removed or renamed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`. Both pass, and `git diff` shows no added `#[allow]`.
criteria.evidence: Athena's records show both commands passed on this tree. Reading `git diff HEAD~1`, no `#[allow` line is added.

criteria.criterion: `git diff --color-moved` shows the S1-S3 body text in crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs as the same text as the lines removed from run/mod.rs. Lines not marked moved are limited to mod/use/visibility lines, stage method signatures, the Stop/Reported types, local-to-field renames and rustfmt rewraps, each listed with its reason in the CHANGELOG entry.
criteria.evidence: The colored output marks the removed baseline block as moved. It was too large to read in full, so I compared the removed text with producer.rs line by line in the plain diff. The bodies are identical except for: `&job_dir`→`job_dir`; `&mut closing`→`closing` in keep_timed_out_work; the four `return Ok(closing)`→`return Ok(Flow::Stop)`; `let mut seq`→`let seq` in the driver plus a `mut seq` parameter; re-declared `let id`/`jc`/`p`; the ProducerWork destructure and construction; and the `Ok(Flow::Go(Reported{..}))` return. The CHANGELOG lists each of these with its reason. Everything else is use lines, signatures or the new types.

criteria.criterion: Each early `return Ok(closing)` in S1-S3 (the producer could not run, timed out, did not complete, returned no valid report) is paired in the CHANGELOG with the Stop that replaced it, with old and new line numbers. The driver in run/mod.rs returns `closing` when it sees Stop. The S4 idle-producer `return Ok(closing)` is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: At the base, `return Ok(closing)` sits at lines 1223, 1236, 1246 and 1256, `sent back` at 1326 and the S4 return at 1364, all as the CHANGELOG says. A Grep finds `return Ok(Flow::Stop)` at producer.rs:188/201/211/221, which also matches. In the driver, mod.rs:1141 is `Flow::Stop => return Ok(closing)`, and the S4 return at mod.rs:1178 is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Grep over crates/athena-core/src/run shows the `baseline   ` ui line and the `producer   sent back:` line only in producer.rs, and one definition of each stage method. `produce_and_verify` calls them in the order baseline, snapshot, producer loop.
criteria.evidence: Grep finds the format strings at producer.rs:60 and :291. The only other hit is a test assertion string at mod.rs:2460 (`assert_eq!(said[1], "baseline   probe ok")`), not the ui line. Grep over crates/ finds exactly one `fn baseline_stage`, `fn producer_snapshot` and `fn producer_loop`, all in producer.rs. mod.rs:1129-1139 calls them in the order baseline_stage, producer_snapshot, producer_loop.

criteria.criterion: The stop value is named the same in code and in docs/design/structure-pass.md (sections 3.3 and 5); Grep finds no `Stage::Stop` left if the code uses `Flow::Stop`, or the reverse.
criteria.evidence: A repo-wide Grep for `Stage::Stop|Flow::Stop` finds only `Flow::Stop`: in structure-pass.md at lines 125, 131 and 251, and in the code. No `Stage::Stop` is left anywhere.

criteria.criterion: The CHANGELOG entry lists every local that crossed the S1-S3 seam and the field or parameter that carries it now. For each moved or new name it gives the Grep over crates/ with file counts before and after, and the counts are equal.
criteria.evidence: The entry lists seq, closing, report, report_gaps, report_kept_in, left_criteria, snapshot, work, grant, composed, capability_env and model, each with what carries it now. My Grep counts on the tree, excluding producer.rs, match the stated after counts: the take_baseline/keep_timed_out_work/PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS/planned_paths/unchanged_planned_files group in 7 files, capability_env in 5, report_kept_in in 1, report_gaps/left_criteria in mod.rs and state.rs. criteria.criterion: `git diff --stat` lists only crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs, CHANGELOG.md and docs/design/structure-pass.md. No test line changes except `use` lines. CHANGELOG.md has an R5 entry under Unreleased saying there is no behavior change, in the style of the R2 and R4 entries.
criteria.evidence: `--stat` lists exactly those four files. No test line changed. The R5 entry sits first under `## [Unreleased]` / `### Changed` and says "No behavior change", in the same style as the R4 entry below it.

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG count for the new names is wrong: `Reported` was already in use before this change.
findings.evidence: The entry says the new names `Flow`, `ProducerWork` and `Reported` are in "0 files before; after, only `producer.rs` and the `run/mod.rs` driver". A whole-word Grep over crates/ excluding producer.rs finds `Reported` (mostly `Provenance::Reported`) in status.rs, scoring.rs, run/close.rs, athena-data records.rs and quantity.rs, and athena-gate reconcile.rs: 6 files before the change, 7 after counting the mod.rs driver. The code is fine; only the recorded count is false.

findings.summary: `seq` now goes into the loop by value and comes back in `Reported`, where the design doc had said `&mut u32`.
findings.evidence: The reading accepts this if it is documented. The design doc now explains it, and the behavior is the same because no other stage reads `seq` between S1 and the end of S3.

summary: The candidate passes. It moves stages S1 to S3 (the baseline, the producer snapshot, and the producer loop with its send-back) out of `produce_and_verify` into three methods in the new run/producer.rs. The moved text is unchanged apart from the edits the CHANGELOG lists, and the four early returns now return `Flow::Stop`, which the driver turns into `return Ok(closing)`. Athena's records show fmt, clippy and the full `cargo test --locked` passing (1617 tests). I ran the produce_and_verify order tests myself: all 12 pass, including the named baseline-order test. I checked every old line number the CHANGELOG cites against the base commit, and every new one against the tree; all are right. The design doc and the code both use the name `Flow::Stop`, and only the four expected files changed. I could not build the base test list without changing git state. It equals the candidate's by construction, because no test line changed. There is one minor finding: the CHANGELOG says `Reported` was in 0 files before, but it was already in 6 files as `Provenance::Reported`.
